headline: Maven school-strike report and Trump's 'hoax' remark lift Self-Destruction
body: A darker day. Bloomberg reported that faulty intelligence and over-reliance on Palantir's Maven AI contributed to a February strike on an Iranian school that killed 123 children; Palantir disputes it. Military AI linked to real harm raises Catastrophic Risk and weakens Alignment & Control, the two biggest drivers of Self-Destruction, the ending where humanity wrecks itself before superintelligence arrives. President Trump, meanwhile, vowed an 'AI Force' and an AI czar while calling safety warnings a 'hoax'. That signals less appetite for coordination and safety work, which hit Gatekeeper, the ending that depends on nations cooperating to cap AI. A new music-label lawsuit against Suno added a sliver of backlash. Horizon Balance fell 1.20 points to -4.95.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +1.5, from the Maven report (+1.03) and Trump's 'AI Force' pledge (+0.49), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.03). Gatekeeper -1.0, mostly from Trump's 'AI Force' pledge (-0.71) and the Maven report (-0.24). Libertarian Utopia -0.8, mostly from the Maven report (-0.60) and Trump's 'AI Force' pledge (-0.20).
